items.html: And we have already explained in the Shema of Yotzer that it is always impossible for all the Mochin of Katnut to be missing from ZA, for necessarily the inner Mochin of Katnut from the side of Ima never depart from him at all, neither by day nor by night; because there must necessarily be for him some aspect of Mochin, by which he will be sustained, for those Mochin are the life and existence of man, in the secret of "and wisdom gives life to its possessors.
